# Generated by tools/syzlang_gen.py from the measured
# inventories. Do not edit by hand: regenerate, or the next run overwrites the
# correction. Driver 610.57.04, checkout e4a5faa.

# Request numbers are literal here because the syzkaller tree carrying
# syz-extract is absent from this repository, so a .const file could not be
# produced against a format this tool can check. nvidia_gspwn.h holds
# the same numbers as _IOWR macros for syz-extract to consume on the SUT.


# The ten modeset handle types. nvkms-api-types.h:55 declares each as
# a plain NvU32 with no class hierarchy behind it, so each is a flat
# resource and none derives from another. Every parameter struct is
# pointed at inout, so one member both produces a handle from a reply
# field and consumes one in a request field.
# NvKmsDeviceHandle, carried by 62 emitted member(s)
resource nvkms_device[int32]
# NvKmsDispHandle, carried by 35 emitted member(s)
resource nvkms_disp[int32]

resource nvkms_connector[int32]

resource nvkms_surface[int32]
# NvKmsFrameLockHandle, carried by 6 emitted member(s)
resource nvkms_frame_lock[int32]
# NvKmsDeferredRequestFifoHandle, carried by 4 emitted member(s)
resource nvkms_deferred_request_fifo[int32]
# NvKmsSwapGroupHandle, carried by 7 emitted member(s)
resource nvkms_swap_group[int32]
# NvKmsVblankSyncObjectHandle, carried by 2 emitted member(s)

# NvKmsVblankIntrCallbackHandle, carried by 2 emitted member(s)

# /dev/nvidia-modeset. The whole command set multiplexes through one
# kernel request number, 0xc0106d00, which nvkms-ioctl.h:47 builds as
# _IOWR(NVKMS_IOCTL_MAGIC, NVKMS_IOCTL_CMD, struct NvKmsIoctlParams).
# nvkms.c reads the leaf from NvKmsIoctlParams.cmd after
# copy_from_user, so each variant pins that field to its dispatch
# ordinal and sets size to its own parameter struct's measured size.
# Two of the 66 declared commands carry no dispatch entry and are
# absent here: NVKMS_IOCTL_GET_3DVISION_DONGLE_PARAM_BYTES and
# NVKMS_IOCTL_SET_3DVISION_AEGIS_PARAMS.
#
# One request number for 64 commands means a strace-shaped trace
# names the family and never the leaf, so tools/trace2seed.py cannot
# recover which modeset command a traced call was. That is a stated
# limitation of this branch and not a defect in the map.
